CustomField.description: THE GRAIN KEY (user decision D-AR-4). One Receivables Summary per occupied unit. There is no Tenant object in this org; Unit__c is the existing Yardi rent-roll mirror and already carries Yardi_Unit_Id__c, Tenant_Name__c and Current_Monthly_Rent__c. A tenant in several suites produces several rows - see the object description for the exposure roll-up.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The Yardi unit this balance belongs to. A tenant occupying more than one suite has one row per suite.
CustomField.label: Unit
